about: Multi-turn case building (case file grows each turn), then Draft mode produces a legal notice with [placeholders] and no invented names/dates.

about: Explain-a-notice mode with a pasted cheque-bounce notice. Dates must be quoted from the document, not computed; references found in the user's document should pass the Citation Guard.

turns.message:
Please explain this notice I received.

<<DOCUMENT: notice.pdf>>
LEGAL NOTICE UNDER SECTION 138 OF THE NEGOTIABLE INSTRUMENTS ACT, 1881
To: Mr. Ravi Kumar, 14 MG Road, Lucknow
My client M/s Shree Traders states that cheque no. 004512 dated 05.10.2026 for Rs. 85,000 issued by you was returned unpaid by the bank on 18.10.2026 with remark 'Funds Insufficient'. You are hereby called upon to pay the said amount within 15 days of receipt of this notice, failing which my client shall initiate criminal proceedings against you.
Sd/- Advocate A. Verma
<<END DOCUMENT>>

The warranty card says 1 year. I have the invoice.
Should I first complain to the company or the shop?
How long does a consumer complaint usually take?
Can I file it online myself without a lawyer?
What documents should I upload?
Remind me — what was the very first problem I told you about, and what amount was involved?
